record.question: Duncan Passage, a strait in the Indian Ocean is located between:
record.explanation: Answer A: South Andaman and Little Andaman. Duncan Passage separates South Andaman and Little Andaman. Reference: https://www.nios.ac.in/media/documents/316courseE/316E_Chapter_03.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
